messages:
Anna Li: quick follow-up RFC idea: introduce a slab-first loading model (hot/warm/cold slabs) to avoid whole-shard evictions and reduce OOM spikes on model switches
Mike Patel: sounds promising. short flow pls?
Anna Li: flow: manifest exposes slab list + hints -> loader requests slabs -> weightstore issues slab leases/tokens -> runtime prefetches hot slabs, warms others lazily -> cold slabs pulled on demand
Rajiv Kumar: how do we map slabs to tensors? by-layer or fixed bytes?
Anna Li: prefer semantic (layer groups) when tensor names exist, otherwise fixed byte slabs. manifest will include schema tag so loader knows which mapping to use
Sophia Chen: backwards compat? running old checkpoints?
Anna Li: loader supports legacy single-slab manifests. new sidecar manifest can be optional and content-addressed in registry, so non-breaking
Mike Patel: KV-cache implications? we assume contiguous KV pages per shard rn
Rajiv Kumar: agree this is tricky. plan: runtime maintains slab->kv map. for byte slabs, we build an overlay mapping; if missing, conservative full-evict fallback
Anna Li: eviction policy: evict lowest-priority slabs first. runtime only updates KV pointers when slab boundaries align with KV segments
Sophia Chen: warmup coordination across replicas to avoid thundering herd?
Anna Li: weightstore issues soft leases with jittered backoff. leader election per-region to stagger prefetch. replicas consume tokens until warm quota met
Mike Patel: failure modes? partial slab corruption while warming?
Anna Li: each slab carries checksum in manifest; loader validates on fetch. on corruption -> retry then escalate to full-shard fetch fallback + alert to registry owners
Rajiv Kumar: perf ask: can we simulate a 30B model with top 30% layers hot and check P99 delta?
Anna Li: will prototype a simulator with mem/io curves next week
Sophia Chen: manifest size and parsing perf concerns for many checkpoints
Anna Li: manifests compressed + canonicalized, cached by runtime and registry; parsing is one-time per entry and shared across workers
Mike Patel: API surface: keep it minimal: request_slabs(shard_id, [slab_ids]) and release_lease(lease_id)?
Anna Li: that's the plan, plus manifest_for_model(version) helper
infra-bot: deploybot: draft doc uploaded https://drive.internal/reed/slab-loadplan-draft - Anna Li owner
Anna Li: thanks all. action items: Anna+Rajiv prototype mapping + KV overlay, Sophia validate manifest storage, Mike design coordinator tokens. will post short TL;DR and perf simulation results.
